root_cause: release.sh validated the exported release candidate with typecheck, unit tests, schema and other guards, but omitted the pnpm lint step required by .github/workflows/ci.yml. A release candidate with Biome errors could therefore pass those release checks and be atomically published to main, then fail CI.

incident_evidence.causal_limit: The observed failed CI commit is later than the 0.2.64 release tag and includes intervening commits. This CI failure does not establish that the exact 0.2.64 release candidate failed lint; it establishes a real missing prepublication gate and shows the class of violation CI rejects.
incident_evidence.first_failed_step: Lint: pnpm lint (biome check .), Found 8 errors and 570 warnings, exit 1
incident_evidence.repair_commit: 5bf716c3f7e9c137f228ad7a6bf7bb9738f89ce1 formatted seven JSON reports and one browser test import; the next release 0.2.65 passed CI

change: Run pnpm -s lint as a mandatory prepublication check against the exact exported candidate. The existing release fixture now injects a lint failure and requires nonzero exit, no unit-test execution, no main advance and no new tag.
verification: Runtime fixture execution delegated to root's sole guarded run; this lane performs syntax and exact-file formatting checks only.
remaining_action: Run scripts/test-release-ship-path.sh against the new script, and optionally against the previous release.sh in a scratch copy to record the fixture's red proof.
